Original manga panel artwork. Black-and-white manga: clean ink linework, screentone shading, solid blacks, high contrast. Black ink and grey screentone only, no colour.
Scene: Rin lands in a crouch on the far roof, one hand on the tiles.
Script context: Rin leaps across the gap between two rooftops, cape snapping behind her. rain streaks catch the lantern light.
Mood: determined.
Setting: Rain market rooftops: Lantern stalls and wet tiles above the night market.
Time of day: night.
Camera: low angle, wide.
Composition: dynamic manga composition with a strong diagonal and a clear focal point; speed lines and motion streaks where the action moves.
Character: Rin Asagiri.
Appearance: short black hair, sharp grey eyes, slim courier build.
Outfit: Courier: hooded rain cape over a messenger jacket, satchel strap.
Layer: draw only this one character, a full pose framed for the shot, with the expression the scene calls for, isolated on a fully transparent background. No setting, no floor or cast shadow, no other characters, no effects.
Rules: original artwork only; no text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, signatures, watermarks or logos; no panel borders, frames or gutters; one single image, not a comic page; non-explicit, no nudity, no gore.
